name: solo-product-studio
description: The full path from a product idea to production: validated direction, hardened behavior spec, MVP plan, a scaffolded repository with enforced gates, and a production-grade build, review, and ship cycle.

interface.shortDescription: Product idea to production, one lifecycle
interface.longDescription: Four skills, one lifecycle. product-studio runs an adaptive QA session and moves an idea through research, UX, behavior specification, MVP planning, and delivery. workflow-init scaffolds the repository that implements it — memory bank, runbooks, acceptance and review gates, hooks, CI. engineering-cycle supplies the depth behind each gate and owns everything after the PR merges: review, security, performance, observability, release, and shipping. product-recheck re-evaluates a project already under development.
defaultPrompt: Use product-studio to help me build a product.
Use workflow-init to set up the agent workflow in this repo.
Use engineering-cycle to implement and ship this.
Use product-recheck to re-evaluate this project.
